data.title: ChatGPT expands mobile dots and work continuity
data.summary: The October 5–9 update adds mobile setup and more context across ChatGPT and Codex work.

sources.title: Create your dot in the ChatGPT mobile app

facts.text: OpenAI’s October 5–9 update describes creating dots on mobile and expanded context from existing chats, Codex threads and automations.

prerequisites: Identify the intended host, task, source data and existing access.
steps: Read the current availability and controls before setting up ongoing work.
Reuse an existing chat or task for the same objective, with a clear desired outcome.
Review connected apps, actions and notification expectations before assigning recurring work.
data.output: A scoped ongoing-work brief and an access review.
validation: The agent works in the intended existing task.
Unchanged state does not generate unwanted notifications.
limitations: Provider release note; Sintra did not create a dot, grant app access or test cross-chat context. The publication date is the dated weekly update, not today’s check.
